tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Flow patterns for a linear transport-type PDE] ↗ thm:local-existence-characteristics 1. ch3:3.2-ex-4\group Method of Characteristics

For $b(x)\cdot Du=0$, $u$ is constant along integral curves of $\dot x=b(x)$. An attracting equilibrium obstructs a global continuous solution unless the incoming boundary values coincide; a flow crossing the domain transports the boundary values smoothly; and a characteristic equilibrium requires matching values on the adjoining flow regions for continuity. \end{example}
